title: Remember Me checkbox is visible on login page
preconditions: User is on the login page
expectedResult: Checkbox labeled "Remember Me" is displayed alongside username/password fields

title: Login with Remember Me checked persists session for 30 days
expectedResult: Login succeeds; session/auth cookie or token is created with an expiry of ~30 days

title: Login with Remember Me unchecked uses default session length
expectedResult: Login succeeds; session/auth cookie or token uses the standard (non-30-day) expiry

title: Session persists after browser restart when Remember Me checked
preconditions: User logged in previously with "Remember Me" checked
expectedResult: User remains logged in without re-entering credentials

title: Session does not persist after browser restart when Remember Me unchecked
preconditions: User logged in previously without checking "Remember Me"
expectedResult: User is prompted to log in again

title: Invalid login attempt with Remember Me checked
expectedResult: Login fails with an error message; no session/cookie is created

title: Remember Me checkbox state does not persist across separate login attempts
preconditions: User is on the login page
steps: Do not submit; reload the login page
expectedResult: Checkbox resets to unchecked on page reload

title: Existing valid login flow unaffected by new checkbox
steps: Submit login without interacting with the checkbox
expectedResult: Login succeeds as before; checkbox defaults to unchecked
